'''2001 Denver World Qualifier sealed deck tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed held in Collectormania, Parker, Colorado on 29 June 2001. It is known from Michael Girard's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2571">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-03-girard-goes-to-denver-6-29-7-1-01d2571/ girard-goes-to-denver-6-29-7-1-01], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 3 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-03-girard-goes-to-denver-6-29-7-1-01d2571/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 Denver World Qualifier]].

* '''Date:''' 29 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Collectormania, Parker, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
